prompt: In the standard (x,y) coordinate plane, a translation maps point A(−2, 0) to point A′(5, 3). The same translation maps point C to point C′(−6, 10). What is the x-coordinate of point C ?
In the standard (x,y) coordinate plane, point A is at (2, −3) and point B is at (18, 9). Point P lies on segment AB so that AP : PB = 3 : 1. What is the x-coordinate of P ?
The measures of the three exterior angles of a triangle, one at each vertex, are in the ratio 4 : 5 : 6. What is the measure, in degrees, of the largest interior angle of the triangle?

An isosceles trapezoid has parallel sides of length 10 centimeters and 22 centimeters, and each of its two nonparallel sides is 10 centimeters long. To the nearest tenth of a centimeter, what is the length of a diagonal of the trapezoid?
In the standard (x,y) coordinate plane, what is the shortest distance from the point (−2, −5) to the line 3x + 4y = 12, to the nearest tenth of a unit?

A closed box shaped like a rectangular prism has a square base 12 inches on each side and a height of 8 inches. A thin straight rod runs inside the box from one bottom corner to the top corner farthest from it. To the nearest degree, what is the measure of the angle between the rod and the base of the box?

A right triangle has legs of length 6 centimeters and 8 centimeters. The triangle is rotated 360° about its hypotenuse. To the nearest cubic centimeter, what is the volume of the solid that is swept out? (The volume of a cone with base radius r and height h is (1/3)πr²h.)
In triangle ABC, AB = AC = 13 inches and BC = 10 inches. To the nearest tenth of an inch, what is the length of the median from B, the segment from B to the midpoint of side AC ?

A bucket is shaped like a right circular cone with its tip cut off by a plane parallel to its base. The bottom of the bucket is a circle of radius 6 inches, the open top is a circle of radius 10 inches, and the bucket is 8 inches deep. To the nearest cubic inch, what is the volume of the bucket? (The volume of a cone with base radius r and height h is (1/3)πr²h.)

A person 6 feet tall stands on level ground 20 feet from the base of a vertical lamppost. The lamp at the top of the post is 15 feet above the ground and casts the person's shadow straight away from the post. To the nearest tenth of a foot, how long is the person's shadow?
